name: Ecovacs Deebot T90 Pro Omni
description: Ecovacs' March 2026 flagship robot vacuum/mop, with a 27cm rotating roller mop, hot-water self-cleaning dock, and Ecovacs' own YIKO voice assistant. A published TechRadar review found real-world mapping and mopping performance fell short of its spec sheet.

specs.note: Core cleaning/mapping/YIKO assistant are free; one uncorroborated source cites an optional ~$2.99/mo plan for AI video patrol & extended cloud history — not verified on ecovacs.com

sourcing: Specs sourced from Ecovacs' own US product page (ecovacs.com) and TechRadar's hands-on review, as of September 2026. Two discrepancies between these sources are noted above rather than resolved: price ($799.99 vs. $899.99) and the described obstacle-avoidance sensor (Mini-ToF/RGB camera per Ecovacs vs. a LiDAR turret per TechRadar's review unit). Battery runtime and noise-level figures come from Ecovacs' own marketing and were not independently verified by press. A separate "DEEBOT T90 PRO OMNI CARE" variant also exists on ecovacs.com — do not confuse it with this model. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: Ecovacs' own US store lists **$799.99**, while TechRadar's review reported **$899.99** (£899 / AU$2,299) — robotindex could not resolve which reflects current list price versus a promotional or regional difference, so both are shown above pending clarification.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Ecovacs' page describes Mini-ToF structured light plus an AIVI 3D 4.0 RGB camera for obstacle avoidance, but TechRadar's review unit had a front-mounted LiDAR turret — a discrepancy between marketing and reviewed hardware. The 27cm roller mop auto-lifts ~15mm for carpets. TechRadar's review was critical: six mapping sessions to build a usable floor plan, streaky mopping, missed pet hair.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Ecovacs' own product page describes the T90 Pro Omni's obstacle-avoidance sensor as Mini-ToF structured light plus an AIVI 3D 4.0 RGB camera, but TechRadar's reviewed unit had a front-mounted LiDAR turret instead — a discrepancy that couldn't be reconciled. Price is similarly inconsistent: $799.99 on Ecovacs' own store versus $899.99 in TechRadar's review.

firmwareCommunity.note: Ecovacs Deebot T90 Pro Omni has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
